article.title: What the latest flare-up between the U.S and Iran means
article.author: Mitchell Plitnick
article.content: The U.S. and Iran are trading strikes while carefully avoiding all-out war, and both sides are hiding the damage they've suffered. The difference is Iran has more reason to end the stalemate, and less patience for Washington's forever-war strategy.
